name: YandexGPT Provider
description: Adds YandexGPT (Yandex Foundation Models) as a chat provider for the Drupal AI module via its OpenAI-compatible Yandex Cloud endpoint.
project_description:
Looking for an effective AI model? YandexGPT is one of the best examples. It is a large language model that provides high-quality results in various tasks, such as text generation and conversation. YandexGPT uses advanced algorithms and technologies to ensure ethical AI practices and provide safe and reliable solutions.

 Features 
 Leverage YandexGPT with the full range of the AI module family. Use these models to enhance text processing, content generation, and intelligent conversation flows.

 Get credentials 
 
 The API Key. See documentation https://yandex.cloud/docs/foundation-models/api-ref/authentication#service-account_1 
 The Catalog Identifier. See documentation https://yandex.cloud/docs/resource-manager/operations/folder/get-id . 
 Good article https://habr.com/ru/articles/780008 
 
 Post-Installation 
 
 Configure an API key using the Key module with your YandexGPT API credentials. 
 Go to /admin/config/ai/providers/yandex and connect the API key. 
 You’re ready to start using the YandexGPT models in your AI applications. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 The AI module .

 Community Documentation 
 The documentation is available on https://project.pages.drupalcode.org/ai/
